en.headline: Female road worker killed by dump truck in Sha Tin
en.dek: A woman died after a dump truck struck and ran over her at a road-widening site on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday morning. Police are investigating.
body: Police said a female road worker died at the scene after being struck by a dump truck on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Estate shortly before 11am on Thursday.

According to reports, the incident occurred at the entrance to a road-widening works site on the Sha Tin T4 trunk road project. The woman was reportedly washing vehicle tyres with a hose when the truck, leaving the site, hit her with its left front and then ran over her with a rear wheel before stopping about 20 metres away.

Rescue crews confirmed she had died and did not transport her to hospital. The Transport Department said the slow lane towards Ma On Shan was closed, with traffic using the remaining lanes. Police are investigating the circumstances.

zh.headline: 沙田路修路女工遭泥頭車輾斃
zh.dek: 周四早上沙田路近博康邨路面擴闊工地，一名女工遭泥頭車撞倒輾過後當場死亡，警方正調查。
body: 警方表示，周四早上近11時，沙田路往大埔方向近博康邨一帶發生致命交通意外，一名女工人遭泥頭車撞倒後死亡。
據了解，現場正進行沙田T4號主幹路路面擴闊工程，女工在工地出入口用水喉清洗車輛車胎時，駛離的泥頭車左車頭將其撞倒，左尾輪繼而輾過，車輛駛出約20米才停下。
救援人員到場後證實女工已明顯死亡，毋須送院。運輸署指往馬鞍山方向的慢線已封閉，駕駛人士需使用餘下行車線。警方正調查事件。
